summary: Base policy and config alone judge the current PR; head candidates are validated for schema, references, coverage, parity and schema-specific monotonicity, and only mechanically proven tightening or equivalent changes proceed without a weaken-policy authorization.
rationale: A merged weaker policy would become the next trusted base. A fixed list of weakening types is incomplete, so unknown semantic changes fail closed and new schema fields must declare monotonicity. Starting with zero comparators is the most conservative valid instance; comparators are added by change frequency, beginning with profiles/ifx/rules and policy/g04/bindings. Plan 06 sections 12.4 and 17 D13; review sections 10.3, 11.3, 12.1 and 13.2.
